perks.name: Resonant Plating
perks.description: Your health begins regenerating immediately after taking melee damage from a powerful combatant.
perks.exact:
Upon receiving a Melee Attack from a Miniboss+ Combatant:
Begins Health Regeneration.

perks.name: Siphoning Touch
perks.description: Gain stacks of Siphoning Touch for weapon or Glaive melee hits. Switching weapons heals you and consumes all stacks.
perks.exact:
Upon scoring weapon damage instances or a Glaive Melee Attack:
Grants a stack of Siphoning Touch, up to a maximum of 5 stacks.
x1 = ~26.7% of Mag | x2 = ~53.4% | x3 = ~80% | x4 = ~106% | x5 = ~133%
Scorch does not count for damage instances. Always rounds down.

On Weapon Stow:
Consumes all Siphoning Touch to restores HP, based on the stack amount.
30 | 60 | 90 | 105 | 120 HP restored.

item.name: Grenade Kickstart
item.description: Collecting an Orb of Power causes you to gain 1 temporary Armor Charge.
item.exact:
On Grenade Ability Usage while having Armor Charges:

Consumes all Armor Charges to grant Grenade Ability Energy. 

Ability Energy Gains are based on the sum of number of Armor Charges consumed and Mod copies equipped.

Grenade Ability Energy:
16.2% | 21.7% | 28.4% | 34.4% | 38.4% | 41.3% | 43.4% | 45%
12.5% | 14.2% | 16.2% | 18.7% | 21.7% | 25% | 28.4% | 31.6%

item.name: Firepower
item.description: Your grenade final blows create Orbs of Power.
item.exact:
On Grenade Kill:
Spawns a Orb of Power.

Orb of Power:
0.8% | 1.1% | 1.25% | 1.5% Super Energy.

Incurs a 10 | 5 | 1 second cooldown between Orbs.
Can trigger alongside Heavy Handed if equipped before it.
From left to right order.
